title: Several Atlassian products: security flaw used in attacks
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 33 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched. Ready-made attack tools are public. The severity score is critical (9.3). The exploit prediction score is 100%.

category.label: Documents and collaboration
category.why: It holds shared documents and internal pages.
category.doThis: Patch it, or ask your provider whether they have.

summary: Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in…
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Oct 18, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
